sinopsis.es: «Stories that shape the paths along which the water flows Voices that travel between the sky and the mountains The wind and its whistling frighten the water The earth chokes A storm of tears trickles down the skin It is the salt that cultivates the streams to wander Voices that travel between the sky and the mountains»
